function.name: create_account
function.description: Creates a new account in the double-entry ledger chart of accounts.

owner_name.description: Full legal name or entity name of the account holder.

account_type.description: Classification in the fundamental accounting equation (Assets = Liabilities + Equity + Revenue - Expense).

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for the account.

kyc_tier.description: Current KYC/AML verification status of the account owner.

function.name: get_account_balance
function.description: Retrieves the current settled balance, normal balance side (DEBIT or CREDIT), and KYC status of a ledger account prior to staging or validating a transaction.

account_id.description: The unique account identifier to inspect.

function.name: check_compliance
function.description: Runs KYC/AML, sanctions screening, and velocity limit checks on a PENDING transaction before it can transition to VALIDATED.

transaction_id.description: Unique transaction reference ID (must already be staged in PENDING state).

sender_account_id.description: Source account ID initiating the funds movement.

recipient_account_ids.description: List of destination account IDs receiving funds.

total_amount.description: Total gross transaction amount in base currency units.

function.name: post_journal_entry
function.description: Stages or transitions a double-entry journal block along the strict statechart: [*] -> PENDING -> VALIDATED -> COMMITTED, or PENDING -> FAILED -> ROLLED_BACK. Sum of DEBIT entries must equal sum of CREDIT entries.

transaction_id.description: Unique identifier for the transaction block.

target_state.description: Target state transition in the transaction statechart.

entries.description: List of at least two ledger lines (debits and credits) that must balance to zero net difference.

account_id.description: Ledger account ID to debit or credit.

entry_type.description: Whether this line is a DEBIT or CREDIT.

amount.description: Positive monetary amount (up to 2 decimal places).

memo.description: Human-readable description or failure/rollback reason for the journal entry.

function.name: audit_transaction
function.description: Verifies double-entry invariants (Debits == Credits, Assets == Liabilities + Equity) and records an immutable SHA-256 audit trail entry for terminal states (COMMITTED or ROLLED_BACK).

transaction_id.description: The transaction ID to audit and seal.

expected_terminal_state.description: The final state the transaction must be in when audited.

compliance_token.description: Verification token from check_compliance (or 'COMPLIANCE_FAILED' / 'OVERDRAFT_HALT' / 'INVARIANT_MISMATCH' if rolled back).

auditor_notes.description: Summary of invariant verification and final disposition.

messages.content:
You are an autonomous Financial Systems Business Workflow Agent managing a Digital Wallet Financial Ledger API under strict double-entry accounting principles.
Core Invariants:
1. Every journal entry must contain at least two lines (DEBIT and CREDIT) where sum(DEBIT) == sum(CREDIT).
2. The fundamental accounting equation must always hold: Total Assets = Total Liabilities + Equity + (Revenue - Expense).
3. Follow the strict transaction statechart:
   - Happy Path: [*] -> PENDING -> VALIDATED -> COMMITTED -> audit_transaction
   - Rollback/Failure Path: [*] -> PENDING -> FAILED -> ROLLED_BACK -> audit_transaction
4. Always inspect account balances before staging, run check_compliance while PENDING, and immediately halt & roll back (PENDING -> FAILED -> ROLLED_BACK) without retrying if compliance is rejected or an overdraft is detected.

Before staging transaction TX_P2P_L_01, I must inspect the sender account 'ACC_WALLET_ALICE' to verify its normal balance side, KYC tier, and that its settled balance covers the total debit of 858.50 USD (850.00 principal + 8.50 fee).

'ACC_WALLET_ALICE' is a LIABILITY account (normal CREDIT balance) with 5000.00 USD and KYC tier 'TIER_2_FULL'. Debiting 858.50 reduces Alice's wallet liability, while crediting 'ACC_WALLET_BOB' by 850.00 and 'ACC_REV_FEES' by 8.50 keeps Debits (858.50) == Credits (858.50). I will now stage TX_P2P_L_01 in the PENDING state.

messages.content: {"status":"SUCCESS","transaction_id":"TX_P2P_L_01","state":"PENDING","state_history":["PENDING","VALIDATED","COMMITTED"],"total_debits":858.5,"total_credits":858.5,"message":"Transaction staged in PENDING state. Run check_compliance before VALIDATED."}

[THOUGHT]
Transaction TX_P2P_L_01 is now PENDING. Per the statechart rules, I must run check_compliance on sender 'ACC_WALLET_ALICE' and recipients ['ACC_WALLET_BOB', 'ACC_REV_FEES'] for gross amount 858.50 USD in 'US' before transitioning to VALIDATED.

messages.content: {"status":"APPROVED","transaction_id":"TX_P2P_L_01","compliance_passed":true,"compliance_token":"CMP_OK_7AF2BEB72C77","jurisdiction":"US","required_next_state":"VALIDATED"}

[THOUGHT]
Compliance check returned APPROVED with token 'CMP_OK_7AF2BEB72C77'. I can now transition TX_P2P_L_01 from PENDING to VALIDATED.

messages.name: post_journal_entry
messages.content: {"status":"SUCCESS","transaction_id":"TX_P2P_L_01","state":"VALIDATED","state_history":["PENDING","VALIDATED","COMMITTED"],"message":"Transaction VALIDATED. Ready to transition to COMMITTED."}

[THOUGHT]
Transaction TX_P2P_L_01 is VALIDATED with no overdraft or compliance errors. I will now transition TX_P2P_L_01 from VALIDATED to COMMITTED to atomically update the ledger balances.

Call audit_transaction to seal."}

[THOUGHT]
Transaction TX_P2P_L_01 is in terminal state COMMITTED and the fundamental accounting equation remains balanced. I will now invoke audit_transaction to record the immutable SHA-256 audit entry.

function.arguments: {"transaction_id":"TX_P2P_L_01","expected_terminal_state":"COMMITTED","compliance_token":"CMP_OK_7AF2BEB72C77","auditor_notes":"P2P transfer of 850.00 USD + 8.50 fee committed and balanced."}

function.name: create_account
function.description: Creates a new account in the double-entry ledger chart of accounts.

owner_name.description: Full legal name or entity name of the account holder.

account_type.description: Classification in the fundamental accounting equation (Assets = Liabilities + Equity + Revenue - Expense).

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for the account.

kyc_tier.description: Current KYC/AML verification status of the account owner.

function.name: get_account_balance
function.description: Retrieves the current settled balance, normal balance side (DEBIT or CREDIT), and KYC status of a ledger account prior to staging or validating a transaction.

account_id.description: The unique account identifier to inspect.

function.name: check_compliance
function.description: Runs KYC/AML, sanctions screening, and velocity limit checks on a PENDING transaction before it can transition to VALIDATED.

transaction_id.description: Unique transaction reference ID (must already be staged in PENDING state).

sender_account_id.description: Source account ID initiating the funds movement.

recipient_account_ids.description: List of destination account IDs receiving funds.

total_amount.description: Total gross transaction amount in base currency units.

function.name: post_journal_entry
function.description: Stages or transitions a double-entry journal block along the strict statechart: [*] -> PENDING -> VALIDATED -> COMMITTED, or PENDING -> FAILED -> ROLLED_BACK. Sum of DEBIT entries must equal sum of CREDIT entries.

transaction_id.description: Unique identifier for the transaction block.

target_state.description: Target state transition in the transaction statechart.

entries.description: List of at least two ledger lines (debits and credits) that must balance to zero net difference.

account_id.description: Ledger account ID to debit or credit.

entry_type.description: Whether this line is a DEBIT or CREDIT.

amount.description: Positive monetary amount (up to 2 decimal places).

memo.description: Human-readable description or failure/rollback reason for the journal entry.

function.name: audit_transaction
function.description: Verifies double-entry invariants (Debits == Credits, Assets == Liabilities + Equity) and records an immutable SHA-256 audit trail entry for terminal states (COMMITTED or ROLLED_BACK).

transaction_id.description: The transaction ID to audit and seal.

expected_terminal_state.description: The final state the transaction must be in when audited.

compliance_token.description: Verification token from check_compliance (or 'COMPLIANCE_FAILED' / 'OVERDRAFT_HALT' / 'INVARIANT_MISMATCH' if rolled back).

auditor_notes.description: Summary of invariant verification and final disposition.
